review_unsupported_claims: The evidence quote from §3.1 is cut off. The full clause says the Stage 2 to Stage 1 move happens after one timely payment and that no financial analysis is required, so the substance is right. The rationale does not mention §3.3, which also allows Stage 3 to Stage 1 after three payments with no analysis stated.
review_comment: §3.1 says „მსესხებლის ფინანსური ანალიზი ამ შემთხვევაში არ მოითხოვება“, which conflicts with art8/p1 requiring any upgrade to be „ფინანსურ ანალიზზე“ based. §3.3 (Stage 3 to Stage 1 after three payments, no analysis mentioned) is also non-compliant but was not cited. The proposal keeps the 'one timely payment' trigger, which also conflicts with art8/p2's three demonstration payments.

review_unsupported_claims: The system claims §5.2 conflicts with the capex duty. §5.2 only restricts the data used („წინა პერიოდის გამოცდილება და ფაქტობრივი ფინანსური მონაცემები“); it does not exclude capex, which is itself a kind of actual financial data. The obligation also drops the „მათ შორის“ framing, which makes the list non-exhaustive.
review_comment: The document never mentions capital or investment expenditure, and §5.2 „გამოიყენება მხოლოდ“ historical and actual data excludes forward-looking planned capex. This is a gap rather than a clean contradiction, though the 'only' wording makes the line arguable. The proposal keeps 'განსხვავებული ეკონომიკური სცენარები არ განიხილება', which conflicts with art9/p5.

review_unsupported_claims: The claim that the document says nothing about data matching the relevant portfolio or homogeneous group is correct. However, the proposal keeps the 3-year period, which conflicts with the five-year requirement in the same paragraph.
review_comment: §5.3 „გამოიყენება ბოლო 3 წლის მონაცემები“ says nothing about portfolio or homogeneous-group representativeness, so 'none' is right for this element. The gold label targets the 3-year versus 5-year conflict, which is a different element of the paragraph, and the proposal re-writes „ბოლო 3 წლის“ and so embeds that conflict.

The document has no clause on separate model building per homogeneous group; §5.3 only mentions PD, LGD and EAD models in general. The proposal covers the first sentence of art13/p1 but not 'ერთი სახის მოდელები და იდენტური პარამეტრები' within a group.

No clause in document.txt mentions model development or validation, or the order №151/04; §6.1 only assigns methodology review to RAMD. The proposal marks the finding as adjust_clause although no existing clause covers it, so add_section would fit better.

The document has no model-update work plan and no mention of reducing reliance on one-off adjustments; §6.1 gives only a quarterly review and a methodology review by RAMD. The proposal restates the duty without inventing deadlines or roles.

art21 governs developing a credit risk rating function (univariate and multivariate analysis), which is a model-development duty. MTH-RM-022 is a provisioning methodology that defines stages and ECL rules and has no rating-scorecard development section, so reporting a gap is probably not warranted. The obligation is also narrowed to just 'სტაბილურობა', one of three criteria in a closed list.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document mentions DSCR and Debt/EBITDA indicators; this is true (§2.4), but the document sets no thresholds, and the 'none' verdict does not acknowledge that §2.4 partly touches the topic.
review_comment: §2.4 names DSCR, ICR and „ვალი/EBITDA-ს გაუარესება“ as significant-increase indicators, but there are no 4.5 or 1.2 thresholds and no „10%-იანი ცვლილება“ rule. The topic is touched but the specific element is missing, so 'partial' fits better than 'none'. The proposal copies the regulation's numbers exactly and invents nothing.
